summary: Iteration 76 — verified Magazzino (inventory) CRUD, Day-close (stock decrement + HACCP sync + archive), bundle checkout via pytest (9/9 passed) and full frontend E2E on the public URL: login as admin, 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' tool favorites (no auto-add on tool open, star adds, fav-remove removes), complete 3-step Chiusura Turno & Registro HACCP wizard ending in the celebration overlay, and the header language switcher (IT/DE only). All test data created (inventory TEST_*, day_closures, haccp_logs for lot ML-20260826-*) was deleted afterwards; admin inventory restored to its original (empty) state.

minor.issue: Response leaks internal owner_id (user_id) — other endpoints strip it. Should be projected out like the POST /api/day-close response does.

Creates one haccp_logs entry per temp row even when temp_c is null/empty. Real UI run with 3 prefilled cells and no values recorded produced 3 HACCP entries with temp_c=null (haccp_created=4), while the wizard Step-3 summary said 'Temperature registrate: 0'. Register gets polluted with meaningless rows. Fix: skip temps with temp_c in (None,'') server-side and/or filter in DayClose.doClose.

design_issues.screen: Il Tuo Laboratorio — tools grid (APRI UNO STRUMENTO)
issues: Red 'NUOVO' badge overlaps the tool label text on every card (e.g. 'I Miei Dati', 'Adatta Forno', 'Registro HACCP') making labels partially unreadable — badge should be above the icon or the card should have more bottom padding.

Still show the 🇬🇧 EN flag ('Il tuo compagno digitale 🇮🇹 🇩🇪 🇬🇧' Home.jsx:130, AuthScreen.jsx:81) although the language selector was reduced to IT/DE. Home.jsx also still has a lang === 'en' branch. IntroGuide chips are correctly IT/DE only.

action_items: Do not create HACCP entries for temperature rows without a value (server-side skip and/or filter in DayClose.doClose) so haccp_created matches the wizard summary.
Fix 'NUOVO' badge overlapping tool labels in the tools grid.
Remove leftover 🇬🇧/EN references in Home.jsx:130 and AuthScreen.jsx:81.
critical_code_review_comments: day_close(): fuzzy substring matching (len>=4 and 'in') can hit the wrong item, e.g. consuming 'Farina 0' can decrement 'Farina 00' depending on insertion order; matching stops at the first hit. Consider exact-match first, then fuzzy, and prefer the longest common match.
inventory_save() does delete_many + insert_many without a transaction — a failure mid-way wipes the user's whole warehouse. Consider bulk upserts keyed on id.

DayClose.jsx doClose(): `await saveInventory().catch(()=>{})` relies on saveInventory swallowing errors internally; if the save fails the closure still proceeds and decrements stock from stale server data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (favorites, dayclose wizard, lang switcher)

rca_of_the_issue: Empty-temperature HACCP rows: DayClose.doClose sends every temp row whose name is set (temp_c mapped to null when blank), and the backend loop only checks the name, so the 3 default prefilled cells (Frigo/Cella di lievitazione/Freezer) always generate HACCP entries even with no reading.
